name: Tidio
subcategory: help desks, live chat and support knowledge
tagline: Run website chat, canned replies, and a simple support inbox

pricing.notes: Typical Starter monthly package; conversation limits apply.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.limits: 50 billable human conversations/month; 10 seats; 100 Flows visitors/month; first 50 Lyro conversations free for the account lifetime
tiers.notes: A human reply or proactive human message makes a conversation billable; visitor messages left unanswered do not count.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.limits: 100 billable conversations/month; 10 seats; 100 Flows visitors/month; 50 Lyro conversations one-time
tiers.notes: Monthly price is the annual price reversed using the explicitly stated two-month-free annual structure and the vendor's $29 monthly list price.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.limits: Starts at 250 billable conversations/month and scales to 2,000; 10 seats; advanced analytics and assignment
tiers.notes: Base price shown for 250 conversations; higher conversation quotas cost more.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.limits: Custom billable-conversation and seat limits; departments, multiproject, OpenAPI and custom branding
tiers.notes: Starts at $300/month plus monthly usage; exact annual effective price is quote-dependent.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.limits: Custom conversations; from 3,000 Lyro AI conversations; pay-per-resolution; guaranteed 50% Lyro resolution rate

pricing.freeTierCaps: 50 billable human conversations/month, 10 seats, 100 Flows visitors/month, plus 50 Lyro AI conversations once per account lifetime
pricing.billingTerms: monthly + annual (annual gives 2 months free); Plus/Premium are sales-assisted and usage-priced
pricing.hiddenCosts: Growth rises with conversation quota. Lyro is sold separately from $32.50/month for 50 AI conversations and Flows from $24.17/month for 2,000 visitors; volumes above 1,000 Lyro conversations or 100,000 Flow visitors require a custom plan. Removing Tidio branding is a $16.67/month add-on.

verdictSummary: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Tidio, run website chat, canned replies, and a simple support inbox. The hard boundary is hosted chat network, bots, ai agent, email, analytics, and ecommerce integrations, plus channel integrations and support operations.
coreLoopDIY: Receive website chat messages, route them into a shared support inbox, reply from one place with canned replies, and retain a searchable conversation history.
whatYouLose: hosted chat network, bots, AI agent, email, analytics, and ecommerce integrations
ongoingBurden: message delivery, webhooks, threading, identity, permissions, attachments, notifications, spam, search, uptime, and retention
whyPeopleStillPay: People still pay for Tidio because support software survives because missing or misrouting one customer message is expensive and every channel behaves differently. The recurring cost buys message delivery, webhooks, threading, identity, permissions, attachments, notifications, spam, search, uptime, and retention, not just the visible interface.

priorArt.name: Chatwoot
priorArt.desc: Mature open-source customer engagement and shared-inbox platform.

alternatives.name: Chatwoot
alternatives.desc: A proper support inbox with chat, email and a help center; free software, billable server chores.

facts.install: Docker Compose on a Linux VM, followed by environment, database, reverse-proxy and TLS configuration
facts.dataFormat: Application data in PostgreSQL, queues/cache in Redis, and attachments on local disk or S3-compatible/cloud object storage
facts.gapVsPaid: You give up Tidio's hosted simplicity and take responsibility for Chatwoot's server, upgrades, backups and email delivery.
facts.setupBlocker: Provisioning a Linux server and correctly wiring DNS/TLS, SMTP, PostgreSQL/Redis and storage

alternatives.name: HubSpot Free CRM
alternatives.desc: A two-seat shared inbox and live chat bolted to a CRM; free until the limits become colleagues.

facts.install: Hosted signup, then connect a team inbox/email and add the website tracking or chat-widget code
facts.dataFormat: CRM contacts and conversation history in HubSpot's cloud; records export to spreadsheet files and conversations are available through its API
facts.gapVsPaid: The two-user free inbox is CRM-first and less streamlined for website-chat support than Tidio.
facts.setupBlocker: Connecting and verifying the shared email inbox and website domain

alternatives.name: Live Helper Chat
alternatives.desc: A battle-tested live-chat desk with routing, transcripts and canned replies; the interface has seen some things.

facts.install: Upload the release archive to a PHP web server and run the browser installer, or deploy its Docker image
facts.dataFormat: Chats and settings in MySQL/MariaDB, with uploads and media in writable server-side storage directories
facts.gapVsPaid: Its interface and automation feel older and less polished than Tidio's small-team chat desk.
facts.setupBlocker: A PHP 8.2+/MySQL web host, a pre-created database and correct filesystem permissions

alternatives.name: tawk.to
alternatives.desc: Live chat, tickets and a knowledge base for zero dollars; the little badge is how the arithmetic survives.

facts.install: Hosted signup, then paste the generated JavaScript widget or install a CMS plugin
facts.dataFormat: Chats, tickets and contacts in tawk.to's cloud account; chat and ticket exports are JSON
facts.gapVsPaid: The free widget retains tawk.to branding and its canned-reply and automation experience is less refined than Tidio's.
facts.setupBlocker: Access to edit the website or install its CMS plugin

alternatives.name: LibreDesk
alternatives.desc: A modern email-and-live-chat desk in one compact stack, because apparently that was allowed.

facts.install: Run Docker Compose with an edited config file, or launch the release binary against PostgreSQL
facts.dataFormat: Records in PostgreSQL, queues/cache in Redis, and uploads on the local filesystem or S3-compatible object storage
facts.gapVsPaid: LibreDesk is newer and less proven, with a much smaller integration ecosystem than Tidio.
facts.setupBlocker: Docker plus a correct config, encryption key, PostgreSQL/Redis and mail/channel credentials

alternatives.name: Odoo Helpdesk One App Free
alternatives.desc: A real hosted ticket desk for unlimited users, as long as Helpdesk is your one free Odoo app.

facts.install: Hosted Odoo Online signup with Helpdesk selected as the single free app
facts.dataFormat: An Odoo Online PostgreSQL database in Odoo's cloud, with record exports and downloadable ZIP database backups
facts.gapVsPaid: The one-app-free rule and broad Odoo shell are less direct than Tidio's purpose-built chat and inbox.

alternatives.name: HubSpot Free Help Desk
alternatives.desc: A hosted shared inbox, live chat, and ticket queue for two users; the knowledge base lives upstairs.

facts.install: Hosted signup, then connect a team inbox/email and add the website tracking or chat-widget code
facts.dataFormat: CRM records, tickets and conversation history in HubSpot's cloud; records export to spreadsheet files and conversations are available through its API
facts.gapVsPaid: The two-user ceiling and CRM-oriented workflow make it a narrower replacement than Tidio.
facts.setupBlocker: Connecting and verifying the shared email inbox and website domain

notes: Editorial comparison targets the Starter plan and a small-team shared inbox DIY substitute. Recheck price before merge.
prompt:
Build a personal replacement for Tidio in an empty repository.
Use Next.js 15, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, WebSockets, and Docker Compose; do not offer alternative stacks.
The core loop is: receive website chat messages, route them into a shared support inbox, reply from one place with canned replies, and retain a searchable conversation history.
Make the first run work locally with one documented command.
Store all user data locally by default and make export straightforward.
Put secrets in .env, ship .env.example, and never commit credentials.
Implement one workspace, agents, contacts, inboxes, conversations, messages, labels, and assignment.
Provide a website chat widget with reconnect, unread counts, file limits, and clear availability state.
Create a shared inbox with filters, collision warnings, notes, canned replies, and searchable history.
Add email notifications, browser notifications, and an immutable assignment and status log.
Implement spam controls, attachment scanning hooks, retention settings, export, and contact deletion.
Ship Docker Compose, backups, health checks, migrations, and a documented admin recovery flow.
Include clear empty, loading, success, and recoverable error states.
Add input validation, safe filenames, and graceful handling of unavailable APIs.
Write focused tests for the core transformation and one end-to-end happy path.
Create a README with setup, architecture, permissions, data location, and backup steps.
Do not add accounts, billing, telemetry, analytics, or a hosted control plane.
Deliberately leave out many social and messaging channels.
Deliberately leave out AI agents trained on proprietary support data.
Deliberately leave out enterprise workforce management, SSO, and compliance.
Finish by running the tests and listing the exact commands used.
